summary: community.hrobot now depends on community.library_inventory_filtering_v1 for its inventory plugin. It is installed automatically via the Ansible package or ansible-galaxy, but must be added manually otherwise.
questions: Do I need an extra collection for the hrobot inventory plugin?
What happens if I git clone community.hrobot without dependencies?

answer_card.title: community.hrobot inventory filtering dependency
answer_card.answer_md: The hrobot inventory plugin needs `community.library_inventory_filtering_v1`. It comes automatically with the Ansible package or `ansible-galaxy`. Install it yourself for manual installs.
